review.rationale: Option A correctly identifies the R4 failure as a contract underspecification rather than a repository or prefix error. The observed stdout digital-biosphere-architecture/\n (SHA-256 996e96d716cc85b64b8dd5cb6026feaa74526628dd7d28531ba4af2d121f52e4) is exactly one UTF-8 line with one terminal LF, which is the correct CLI serialization for git rev-parse --show-prefix. The recommendation properly binds three layers (raw bytes, line framing, logical value) without authorizing strip/rstrip or fuzzy whitespace normalization. It preserves the frozen patch, maintains HEAD/remote equality, keeps the exact five-path scope, authorizes no retries or additional validation runs, and respects all operational/commercial/authority boundaries. The R4 failure is correctly preserved as FAIL_CLOSED and not reclassified as PASS.
